lore.en: The ZPD’s first rabbit officer, Judy drives the investigation; the recovered launcher is used only to deliver antidote.

hero.equipmentSource: Recovered from Bellwether’s Night Howler conspiracy, not ZPD issue.
hero.weapon: Recovered Night Howler dart launcher loaded with antidote
hero.spritePrompt: Original fan-made pixel-art sprite sheet, three-quarter RPG battle view. Judy Hopps. Preserve: Small gray rabbit in a fitted blue ZPD patrol uniform, utility belt and long upright ears; original fan-made proportions. No official artwork, logos, text, actor likeness or cross-franchise costume.
hero.name: Judy Hopps

hero.visualAnchor: Slim red fox in light green short-sleeve shirt, striped tie and tan trousers, expressive ears and tail.

lore.fr: Nick met ses combines et sa lecture de la ville au service de l’enquête.
lore.en: Nick puts his hustles and knowledge of the city to work for the case.

lore.fr: Le chef du ZPD engage les moyens de la police lorsque les preuves sont établies.
lore.en: The ZPD chief commits police resources once the evidence is established.
